hero_kpi_rationale: Consolidated revenue is the primary indicator of Crown Holdings' size and scope of operations, reflecting its position as a global leader in the packaging industry.

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by all business activities of the company.
kpis.description: The consolidated revenue of $12.365 billion in 2025 shows an increase compared to 2024, primarily driven by the pass-through of higher raw material costs and volume growth in certain segments.
kpis.signal: Solid growth driven by demand and raw material pricing.

kpis.name: Beverage Can Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the manufacturing of aluminum and steel cans for the beverage industry.
kpis.description: The beverage can segment represents the majority of sales, with $5.615 billion in the Americas, $2.325 billion in Europe, and $1.096 billion in Asia-Pacific in 2025.
kpis.signal: Dominance in the beverage can market, sustained organic growth.

kpis.name: Transit Packaging Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from transit packaging products and related solutions.
kpis.description: This segment includes automation, technology equipment, protective packaging solutions, and steel and plastic consumables. Sales reached $2.026 billion in 2025.
kpis.signal: Slight contraction due to lower equipment volumes and economic uncertainty.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company.
kpis.description: The company employed approximately 23,000 people across 39 countries as of December 31, 2025.

kpis.name: Number of Plants
kpis.explanation: Total number of manufacturing facilities operated by the company.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, the company operated 179 plants across 39 countries.

kpis.name: Cumulative Capacity Investments since 2019
kpis.explanation: Cumulative capital expenditures to increase production capacity since 2019.
kpis.description: Since 2019, the company has invested at least $2 billion in new facilities and production lines to support growing global demand for beverage cans.
kpis.signal: Strategic expansion to meet rising beverage demand.

kpis.name: Planned Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Expected amount for capital spending in the upcoming year.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures to support growth objectives are estimated at $550 million in 2026, including capacity expansions and facility upgrades in Brazil, Greece, and Spain.
kpis.signal: Ongoing investment in capacity expansion and facility modernization.

kpis.name: Raw Material Costs (Aluminum + Steel)
kpis.explanation: Percentage of cost of goods sold attributed to aluminum and steel.
kpis.description: In 2025, aluminum and steel consumption accounted for 47% and 8% of cost of goods sold, respectively, totaling 55%.

kpis.name: Revenue Outside United States
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue generated from international operations.
kpis.description: In 2025, 61% of consolidated revenue came from operations outside the United States.

kpis.name: Beverage Segment Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of total revenue derived from the beverage can segment.
kpis.description: Approximately 72% of the company's consolidated revenue in 2025 came from its global beverage can business.
kpis.signal: High concentration in the beverage market.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Raw Material Prices
risks.score_rationale: Raw material costs represent 47% and 8% of cost of goods sold for aluminum and steel, respectively. Price fluctuations can impact profit margins.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The packaging market is highly competitive, with standardized products and potential overcapacity.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions can have a significant impact on operations and financial results.

risks.title: Demand Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Demand for the company's products may fluctuate based on weather conditions and consumer preferences.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in trade policies and regulations can impact operations and financial results.

risks.title: Asset Impairment Risks
risks.score_rationale: Asset impairments can have a significant impact on financial results.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: Litigation can impact financial results and the company's reputation.
